test_title: RRB Technician Grade III Official Paper (Held On: 23 Dec, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Gopi starts from Point A and drives 100 km towards East. He then takes a left turn, drives 55 km, turns left and drives 75 km. He then takes a left turn and drives 45 km. He takes a final right turn, drives 25 km and stops at Point P. How far (shortest distance) and towards which direction should he drive in order to reach Point A again?

(All turns are 90 degree turns only unless otherwise specified.)
solution:
Given:

Gopi starts from Point A and drives 100 km towards East.

He then takes a left turn, drives 55 km, turns left and drives 75 km.

He then takes a left turn and drives 45 km.

He takes a final right turn, drives 25 km and stops at Point P. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6403105ca6cb83cff8e8b22ee42fa434caa4f8c463cdcdb2768d59dff60b4972.png] 

Thus, Gopi should drive 10 km in the north direction in order to reach Point A again.

Hence, **"Option 2"** is the correct answer.
